overview.zh: 代币化资产正从试点走向主流金融基础设施，而发行方阻力与量子风险构成新的张力。 代币化基础设施：DTCC 代币化服务首批开放 25 种证券，底层 DTC 托管资产约 30 万亿美元，代币沿用相同 CUSIP。 机构抵押品：BNY 与 Citadel Securities 在一笔隔夜回购中使用代币化美国国债，将代币化资产带入短期融资抵押环节。 AI 密码学：Anthropic 称内部 Claude 研究模型在 30 分钟内追溯出五个 NSA 椭圆曲线种子的来源，外部密码学家复现代码核验。
overview.en: Tokenized assets are moving from pilots into core financial plumbing, even as issuer pushback and quantum risk sharpen. Tokenization rails：DTCC's service opens with 25 securities backed by roughly $30 trillion in DTC-custodied assets, with tokens keeping the same CUSIP. Institutional collateral：BNY and Citadel Securities used a tokenized Treasury in an overnight repo, placing tokenized assets in short-term funding collateral. AI cryptography：Anthropic said an internal Claude research model traced five NSA elliptic-curve seeds in under 30 minutes, a result external cryptographers reportedly replicated.

title.zh: 【DTCC 代币化服务首批支持 25 种证券，底层资产规模约 30 万亿美元】
title.en: DTCC's tokenization service launches with 25 securities, backed by roughly $30 trillion in underlying assets

summary.zh:
据 DTCC 公布的代币化服务资料，该服务首批开放 25 种可代币化证券，底层为 DTC 托管的证券，规模约 30 万亿美元。代币与原证券保持 1:1 对应并使用相同 CUSIP，可在 DTC 注册钱包之间进行 24/7 点对点转账，且带有合规转让限制，官方账簿记录仍由 DTC 保管。

由于代币沿用相同的 CUSIP，其权利与投资者保护与簿记证券一致，因此一部分 DTC 托管资产（包括美国国债的派息与到期服务）开始在链上运行，而 DTC 仍保留官方账簿记录的角色。

首批支持的资产包括罗素 1000 成分股（从部分大盘股开始）、部分 ETF 和美国国债；美国国债的派息和到期服务将在链上进行，款项以法币支付至参与者的传统账户。首批上线网络为 Canton Network（CIP-56）和 DTCC 私有 Besu 网络（ERC-20），Stellar（SEP-41）与 Circle 的 Arc（ERC-20）预计于 2027 年接入。
summary.en:
According to materials published by DTCC, its tokenization service has opened with 25 tokenizable securities whose underlying DTC-custodied assets total roughly $30 trillion. The tokens correspond 1:1 to the original securities, carry the same CUSIP, and can be transferred peer-to-peer 24/7 between registered DTC wallets subject to compliance transfer restrictions, while DTC remains the official book of record.

Because the tokens keep the same CUSIP and the same rights and investor protections as book-entry securities, a slice of DTC-custodied assets — including Treasury coupon and maturity servicing — now runs on blockchain rails without DTC ceding its role as the official record keeper.

The first supported assets are Russell 1000 constituents (starting with some large-cap stocks), selected ETFs and U.S. Treasuries; Treasury interest and maturity servicing will occur on-chain, with payments made in fiat to participants' traditional accounts. Initial networks are Canton Network (CIP-56) and DTCC's private Besu network (ERC-20), with Stellar (SEP-41) and Circle's Arc (ERC-20) expected to connect in 2027.

title.zh: Visa 和 Mastercard 在 200 个国家启用 USDC 支付
title.en: Visa and Mastercard adopt USDC payouts across 200 countries

summary.zh:
据 CryptoSlate 报道，Visa 和 Mastercard 正在约 200 个国家启用 USDC 支付，通过全球最大的两家卡组织扩展稳定币结算。按报道所述，这意味着付款可以经由 Circle 发行的美元锚定稳定币通道完成，而不再仅依赖传统的代理行汇款网络。

若 USDC 结算真正接入 Visa 和 Mastercard，稳定币将从加密原生场景进入商户与金融机构广泛使用的主流支付基础设施。检索到的资料显示，卡组织已在并行测试多种稳定币用于结算，这实际上是一场围绕“哪类美元代币能占据结算通道”的竞争。

报道将该举措描述为覆盖约 200 个国家的支付扩展。检索资料提到，Mastercard 于 2026 年 6 月将稳定币结算支持范围扩大至 USDC、PYUSD、RLUSD 和 SoFiUSD，且 SoFi 成为首个在大型卡网络上线的银行发行稳定币。
summary.en:
Visa and Mastercard are enabling USDC payouts across roughly 200 countries, extending stablecoin settlement through the two largest global card networks, according to CryptoSlate. The reported rollout would let payouts be routed in the dollar-pegged stablecoin issued by Circle rather than solely through traditional correspondent banking rails.

Stablecoin settlement through Visa and Mastercard would move USDC from crypto-native venues into mainstream payment infrastructure used by merchants and financial institutions. Search context indicates card networks are already testing multiple stablecoins side by side for settlement, making this a live contest over which dollar tokens sit on those rails.

The report frames the move as a payout expansion spanning about 200 countries. Search excerpts note that Mastercard expanded its stablecoin settlement support in June 2026 to include USDC, PYUSD, RLUSD and SoFiUSD, and that SoFi became the first bank-issued stablecoin to go live on a major card network.

title.zh: BNY与Citadel Securities在隔夜回购交易中使用代币化美国国债
title.en: BNY and Citadel Securities Use Tokenized Treasury in Overnight Repo

summary.zh:
据The Defiant报道，纽约梅隆银行（BNY）与做市商Citadel Securities完成了一笔隔夜回购协议交易，其中使用了代币化美国国债。此举将区块链形式的政府债务工具放入核心的机构短期融资交易之中，而非停留在孤立的代币化试点层面。

隔夜回购是机构以美国国债为抵押进行资金拆借的基础通道，代币化国债在此类交易中的使用，意味着代币化现实世界资产正从投资产品向抵押品与结算功能延伸。

该交易的结构为隔夜回购，即卖出证券并于次日回購的短期有担保贷款。参与方一方是大型托管银行BNY，另一方是美国国债市场最大的中介机构之一Citadel Securities。
summary.en:
BNY (Bank of New York Mellon) and market maker Citadel Securities executed an overnight repurchase agreement in which a tokenized Treasury was used, according to The Defiant. The transaction places a blockchain-represented government debt instrument inside a core short-term institutional funding trade rather than in a standalone tokenization pilot.

Overnight repo is the plumbing through which institutions borrow and lend cash against Treasuries, so using a tokenized Treasury there signals tokenized real-world assets edging from investment products into collateral and settlement functions.

The trade was structured as an overnight repo, a short-term secured loan in which securities are sold and repurchased the next day. It involved BNY, a major custodian bank, and Citadel Securities, one of the largest Treasury market intermediaries.

title.zh: CoreWeave、博通、Verizon等九家公司反对OKXICE对其股票进行代币化交易
title.en: CoreWeave, Broadcom, Verizon among nine companies objecting to tokenized trading of their shares on OKXICE

summary.zh:
据The Block于2026年10月17日报道，包括CoreWeave、博通（Broadcom）和Verizon在内的九家公司对OKXICE促使其股票进行代币化交易表示反对。这些反对意见给代币化股票带来了法律与市场结构方面的问题。

据报道，这些反对意见给代币化股票带来法律与市场结构层面的问题，上市发行方正抵制第三方提供其股票代币版本的做法。

OKXICE是加密货币交易所OKX与洲际交易所（ICE）成立的合资公司，于2026年10月5日向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交申请，拟推出代币化证券平台。其通知涵盖60余家目前在美国证券交易所上市的公司。
summary.en:
Nine companies, including CoreWeave, Broadcom and Verizon, have objected to OKXICE facilitating tokenized trading of their shares, The Block reported on Oct 17, 2026. The objections raise legal and market-structure questions for tokenized equities.

According to the report, the objections raise legal and market-structure questions for tokenized equities, as listed issuers push back against third parties offering token versions of their shares.

OKXICE is the joint venture between crypto exchange OKX and Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) that filed with the SEC on Oct 5, 2026 to launch a tokenized securities platform. Its notice covered more than 60 companies currently listed on US stock exchanges.

title.zh: Strategy 在 MSCI 决定后下跌 9.6%，跌幅超过比特币
title.en: Strategy Slides 9.6% After MSCI Decision, Outpacing Bitcoin’s Drop

summary.zh:
在 MSCI 作出决定后，Strategy 股价下跌 9.6%，跌幅超过同期比特币的下跌幅度。这一跌幅也大于该公司资产负债表上核心资产的表现。

股价跌幅与比特币跌幅之间的差距，凸显出该股票对指数处理方式的敏感度，这一因素独立于其持有的比特币价格本身。

Strategy 是最大的企业比特币持有者，其股票被广泛视为加密概念股的代理标的。此次跌幅超过比特币本身的跌幅，并非简单跟随。
summary.en:
Strategy's shares fell 9.6% following an MSCI decision, a drop larger than bitcoin's decline over the same period. The move outpaced the underlying asset that dominates the company's balance sheet.

The gap between the share move and bitcoin's decline points to the stock's sensitivity to index treatment, a factor separate from the price of the bitcoin it holds.

Strategy is the largest corporate holder of bitcoin, and its equity is widely treated as a crypto-equity proxy. The decline exceeded bitcoin's own move rather than simply mirroring it.

title.zh: “哇，这是一项真正的发现”：Claude 破解了困扰 25 年的 NSA 数字之谜
title.en: ‘Wow, it’s a real discovery’: Claude cracks a 25-year NSA number mystery

summary.zh:
据报道，Anthropic 表示其内部一款 Claude 研究模型在不到 30 分钟内追溯出五个由 NSA 提供的椭圆曲线种子的来源，解决了一个悬置约 25 年的密码学问题。这些种子被追溯到一段旧的计算机程序以及 1997 至 1998 年的 Unix 时间戳。

这些种子来源不明，长期引发外界怀疑：这套标准化曲线参数中或许藏有被人为植入的弱点。报道称，追溯结果显示其源自标准的随机数生成方式，而外部密码学家据称已通过复现代码对这一结果进行了核验。

报道称，这项工作由 Anthropic 内部的一款研究模型完成，而非公开发布的产品。The Crypto Times 的另一篇报道还称 Claude 将量子电路的门数量削减了 17 倍，但现有材料未对该说法给出细节。
summary.en:
Anthropic said an internal Claude research model traced the origins of five NSA-supplied elliptic-curve seeds in under 30 minutes, resolving a cryptography question that had stayed open for roughly 25 years, according to reports. The seeds were traced to an old computer program and to Unix timestamps dating from 1997–98.

The seeds' unexplained provenance had long fed suspicion that the standardized curve parameters might conceal a deliberately planted weakness. Reports said the traced origin points to standard random-number generation, a finding that external cryptographers reportedly checked by replicating the code.

Reports said the work was carried out by an internal Anthropic research model rather than a publicly released product. Separate coverage by The Crypto Times also credited Claude with cutting quantum circuit gate counts 17-fold, a claim not detailed in the available material.

title.zh: 谷歌4个Gemini 4 Argon通关《我的世界》：27小时死605次，花费约520美元
title.en: Google's 4 Gemini 4 Argon Agents Beat Minecraft: 27 Hours, 605 Deaths, About $520

summary.zh:
Google DeepMind 让 4 个 Gemini 4 Argon 编程 Agent 进入随机生成的《我的世界》生存世界，只给它们一个目标：击败末影龙。研究者没有预设分工，也没有编写专用游戏脚本；4 个 Agent 通过开源库 Mineflayer 自行编写并执行了 2783 段 JavaScript 程序，在 27 小时 14 分钟后打败末影龙，累计死亡 605 次。

这一实验所强调的进展在于：通用编程 Agent 能够自行规划、编写代码并协作，而今年 9 月完成类似任务的 Claude Opus 5 社区项目依赖 37 个预先开发的游戏工具。

仅最后一关的末影龙就耗费近 14 小时、死亡 69 次；Agent 发现塔顶水晶会不断给龙回血后，用泥土垫高自己，逐个打掉 10 个水晶。整个实验约 22% 的程序执行报错，通关前调用模型约 2.4 万次，处理 13.5 亿输入 Token，其中 91% 命中缓存；按促销 API 标价估算成本约 520 美元，标准价则约 1040 美元。
summary.en:
Google DeepMind placed four Gemini 4 Argon coding agents into a randomly generated Minecraft survival world with a single high-level goal: defeat the Ender Dragon. With no preset division of labor and no game-specific scripts, the agents wrote and executed 2,783 JavaScript programs through the open-source Mineflayer library and killed the dragon after 27 hours and 14 minutes, having died 605 times.

The reported advance is that general-purpose coding agents planned, wrote code and coordinated on their own, unlike a September Claude Opus 5 community project that completed a similar task while relying on 37 pre-developed game tools.

The final Ender Dragon stage alone took nearly 14 hours and 69 deaths; the agents found that the tower crystals kept healing the dragon and used dirt to pillar up and destroy all 10 crystals. About 22% of program executions returned errors, and the run involved roughly 24,000 model calls and 1.35 billion input tokens, 91% of them cache hits, for an estimated cost of about $520 at Gemini 4 Argon's promotional API pricing versus about $1,040 at standard pricing.

title.zh: Coinbase Global（COIN）二元期权获SEC放行，并警示比特币量子风险
title.en: Coinbase Global (COIN) Wins SEC Backing For Binaries And Flags Bitcoin Quantum Risk

summary.zh:
美国证券交易委员会（SEC）批准了一项证券交易所规则变更，允许上市标准化二元期权——当特定公司业绩条件达成时支付预定现金金额，标的指标包括Coinbase交易量、MARA的比特币产量以及Robinhood的相关指标。Coinbase方面则另行警示了量子计算对比特币构成的潜在风险。

这一批准为美国证券交易所提供了依据现行规则上市“事件驱动型”合约的路径，其标的为加密相关公司的经营指标，意味着受监管衍生品的覆盖范围从现货代币扩展到数字资产企业的业务表现。

这些合约是依据现有证券交易所规则获批的，而非通过一套新的加密专门框架。同一篇报道还提到，Coinbase正与Evernorth合作，在2026年转向对一笔规模可观的XRP储备进行主动管理。
summary.en:
The SEC approved a securities-exchange rule change allowing standardized binary options that pay a predetermined cash amount when a specified company performance condition is met, covering metrics such as Coinbase trading volume, MARA's Bitcoin production and Robinhood indicators. Coinbase separately flagged quantum-computing risk to Bitcoin.

The approval gives US securities exchanges a rule-based path to list event-driven contracts tied to crypto-company operating metrics, extending regulated derivatives access around digital-asset firms rather than only spot tokens.

The contracts were cleared under existing securities-exchange rules rather than through a new crypto-specific framework. The same report notes Coinbase is working with Evernorth as it shifts to active management of a sizeable XRP treasury in 2026.

title.zh: 土耳其证实 Hex 创始人 Richard Heart 被捕，称警方查获 715 万美元及六个冷钱包
title.en: Turkey confirms Hex founder Richard Heart's arrest, says police seized $7.15 million and six cold wallets

summary.zh:
土耳其当局证实 Hex 创始人 Richard Heart（法定姓名 Richard James Schueler）已被逮捕，并称警方在其案件中查获 715 万美元资金及六个冷钱包。这是土耳其官方首次公开、正式确认对其采取的拘押行动。

这一确认把此前仅有媒体报道的拘押升级为官方承认的执法行动，也使 Hex、PulseChain 与 PulseX 创始人面临的法律压力从美国扩展到第二个国家司法辖区。

当局明确查获金额为 715 万美元，并表示作为案件的一部分扣押了六个冷钱包。Heart 是 Hex 的创建者，也是 PulseChain 和 PulseX 的创始人。
summary.en:
Turkish authorities confirmed the arrest of Hex founder Richard Heart — legally named Richard James Schueler — and said police seized $7.15 million along with six cold wallets as part of the case against him. The disclosure marks an official, on-the-record confirmation of the detention by Turkish officials.

The confirmation turns a previously reported detention into an officially acknowledged law-enforcement action, adding a second national jurisdiction to the legal pressure on the founder of Hex, PulseChain and PulseX.

Authorities specified the amount seized as $7.15 million and said six cold wallets were taken as part of the case. Heart is the creator of Hex and the founder of PulseChain and PulseX.

title.zh: 币安矿池将于11月10日关闭，记录访问权限两周后终止
title.en: Binance Pool shuts on November 10, with record access ending two weeks later

summary.zh:
币安旗下的比特币矿池服务 Binance Pool 将于11月10日关闭，矿工访问自身记录的权限将在关闭两周后终止，用户需在此期限前完成迁移。

将算力接入 Binance Pool 的矿工必须在11月10日关闭前迁移至其他矿池，而后续的记录访问截止意味着收益与结算数据需在该窗口内导出。

此处涉及两个不同的截止时间：矿池本身于11月10日停止运营，而记录访问权限在此之后仍保留两周，随后终止。
summary.en:
Binance Pool, the exchange's Bitcoin mining pool service, will shut down on November 10, and miners' access to their records will end two weeks after that date, giving users a deadline to move their operations elsewhere.

Miners who direct hashrate to Binance Pool must migrate to another pool before the November 10 shutdown, and the later record-access cutoff means payout and earnings data must be exported within that window.

Two separate deadlines apply: the pool itself stops operating on November 10, while access to records continues for two more weeks before ending.

title.zh: 谷歌量子芯片新突破：降低关键计算错误率，早期比特币钱包量子风险受关注
title.en: Google Quantum Chip Breakthrough: Cuts Error Rate in Key Computation, Quantum Risk to Early Bitcoin Wallets in Focus

summary.zh:
谷歌表示，其 Willow 量子芯片通过一种名为「Cultivation」的方法，将制备量子计算所需特殊状态（Magic States）时的错误率降低约 40 倍，相关研究本周发表于《Science》。该实验实现了约 99.99% 的状态保真度，但仅约 8% 的尝试通过筛选。

谷歌称，该成果有望降低未来大规模量子计算机的硬件开销；同时，这一进展也使早期比特币钱包面临的长期量子风险受到更多关注——这些钱包的公钥已经公开。

研究人员表示，后续仍需扩大实验规模，并解决实时运行及错误纠正等问题。谷歌此前的攻击成本估算已假设采用高效的 Magic States 制备方案，因此本次成果不能简单理解为破解比特币的成本再降低 40 倍。
summary.en:
Google said its Willow quantum chip used a method called "Cultivation" to reduce errors in preparing magic states — a key resource for running quantum computations — by roughly 40 times, with the research published in Science this week. The experiment reached about 99.99% state fidelity, though only around 8% of attempts passed screening.

Google said the result could lower the hardware overhead of future large-scale quantum computers, and the advance has renewed attention on the long-term quantum risk to early Bitcoin wallets whose public keys are already exposed.

Researchers said the experiment still needs to be scaled up and that real-time operation and error correction remain to be solved. Google's earlier attack-cost estimates already assumed an efficient magic-state preparation scheme, so the 40x error reduction should not be read as a 40x cut in the cost of breaking Bitcoin.

title.zh: 突发！DeepSeek新模型发布，超级性价比斩杀一切
title.en: Breaking: DeepSeek releases a new model, 'super cost-effectiveness' beats everything

summary.zh:
DeepSeek 发布 V4.1-Flash-1017 模型，并开放了自研搜索 API。根据 DeepSeek API 文档，新版本已上线官网、App 与 API，在基准测试表现上更强、任务完成更快，输出也比上一版本更短。

DeepSeek 称该版本在性能与成本上相对上一版本实现了帕累托改进。配套的 Search 与 Fetch API 让智能体（Agent）和 RAG 应用可以通过 DeepSeek 自研搜索引擎获取实时网页内容。

据 OpenRouter，模型名中的“1017”对应 2026 年 10 月 17 日的 V4.1 Flash 快照，DeepSeek 以 deepseek-flash 这一 API 模型名提供服务。Ollama 的模型条目则称其为多模态混合专家（MoE）模型，主干参数量 552B，支持最长一百万 token 的上下文。
summary.en:
DeepSeek released the V4.1-Flash-1017 model and opened up its self-developed search API. According to DeepSeek's API documentation, the new version is now live on its website, app and API, and it delivers stronger benchmark performance, faster task completion and shorter outputs than the previous version.

DeepSeek describes the release as a Pareto improvement in both performance and cost relative to the prior version. The accompanying Search and Fetch APIs give agents and RAG applications access to live web content through DeepSeek's in-house search engine.

The "1017" in the model name corresponds to an October 17, 2026 snapshot of V4.1 Flash, served by DeepSeek under the deepseek-flash API model name, according to OpenRouter. A listing on Ollama describes the model as a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts with 552B backbone parameters and support for contexts of up to one million tokens.

title.zh: 清华开源！智能体操作系统任务成本降83%，AI记忆可查可改
title.en: Tsinghua open-sources agent operating system with 83% lower task cost and queryable, editable AI memory

summary.zh:
据量子位报道，清华大学团队开源了一套智能体操作系统，原生支持模型上下文协议（MCP）。团队宣称该系统可将任务成本降低83%，并让AI记忆可查询、可修改。

原生支持MCP意味着基于该系统的智能体可直接接入这一标准已有的工具、数据源与工作流，无需单独编写适配层。

83%的成本降幅来自团队自述、由量子位转述，目前尚无第三方复现，也未公开基准测试的方法细节。
summary.en:
A Tsinghua University team has open-sourced an agent operating system that natively supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP), according to a report by QbitAI. The team claims the system cuts task costs by 83% and gives AI memory that can be queried and modified.

Native MCP support means agents built on the system can connect to the standard's existing tools, data sources and workflows without bespoke adapters.

The 83% cost-reduction figure comes from the team's own account as relayed by QbitAI; no third-party reproduction or benchmark methodology has been disclosed.

title.zh: Anthropic 的 Claude Mythos 5 将椭圆曲线运算量子电路门数削减约 17 倍
title.en: Anthropic’s Claude Mythos 5 Cuts Quantum Circuit Gate Count for Elliptic-Curve O

summary.zh:
10 月 16 日，Anthropic 发布研究称，Claude Mythos 5 在一个自动化评估系统的辅助下，自主重新设计了八个量子电路，覆盖量子化学、优化、物理模拟与数论领域，并称这些新设计优于此前已发表的方法。其中，一个椭圆曲线点加法电路使用的量子门数量减少约 17 倍，但所需量子比特增加 12%；用于优化算法 DQI 的 Reed–Solomon 解码电路门数则减少约 12 倍。

Anthropic 称这些重新设计的电路优于此前已发表的方案，而椭圆曲线点加法的结果关系到评估量子攻击椭圆曲线密码所需的资源规模。该工作目前仍停留在电路设计与验证阶段。

Claude 提出了一种可逆的模逆算法，无需存储分支历史，取代了步骤数量和顺序依赖输入的扩展欧几里得方法。这些结果尚未在真实的量子硬件上验证。
summary.en:
On October 16, Anthropic published research showing that Claude Mythos 5, assisted by an automated evaluation system, autonomously redesigned eight quantum circuits spanning quantum chemistry, optimization, physics simulation and number theory, producing designs the company says outperform previously published methods. Among them, an elliptic-curve point-addition circuit uses roughly 17 times fewer quantum gates while requiring 12% more qubits, and a Reed–Solomon decoding circuit for the optimization algorithm DQI cuts gate count by about 12 times.

Anthropic says the redesigned circuits beat previously published constructions, and the elliptic-curve point-addition result bears on resource estimates for quantum attacks on elliptic-curve cryptography. The work remains at the circuit design and verification stage.

Claude developed a reversible modular inversion algorithm that eliminates the need to store branch history, replacing the extended Euclidean approach whose number and order of steps depend on the input. The results have not yet been validated on actual quantum hardware.
